fields.name: client_key
fields.help: Kaufland Marketplace Client Key (32 characters, seller portal API settings), sent as the Shop-Client-Key header.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The Secret Key (64 characters): signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, full URI, body and Unix timestamp joined by newlines, sent as Shop-Signature with Shop-Timestamp). Never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: storefront
config_fields.help: Kaufland storefront for product calls: de, cz, sk, pl, at, fr, it, es or nl (GET /v2/info/storefront lists yours).

adapter.terms: Kaufland's Marketplace Seller API is SELLER-side: it searches the marketplace catalogue, manages your offers (units) and processes customer orders; it cannot buy.

me.note: GET /v2/info/storefront: the storefronts created for the signed-in seller ({data: ["de", ...]}).

list_products.note: Searches the Kaufland MARKETPLACE catalogue of the configured storefront; `query` (q) is required by the endpoint and `category` is not a filter here. Offers and prices are not embedded in search results.

get_product.note: GET /v2/products/{id_product}?embedded=units: the product with its offers units[{id_unit, condition, amount, price, delivery_time_min/max, seller}]. Unit prices are the API's integer price values, returned as first_offer_price rather than the decimal `price`.

get_order.note: A customer order placed with you: {id_order, ts_created_iso, storefront, order_units[{id_order_unit, status (need_to_be_sent, sent, received, cancelled, returned, ...), price, currency, product}], shipping_address, billing_address, buyer}. Status is tracked per order unit; `status` is the first unit's.

not_offered.create_order: Seller-side API: customers buy on kaufland.de; the API sends, cancels and refunds order units but cannot place an order.
not_offered.quote_shipping: No rate quote endpoint; shipping is configured per offer through shipping groups (GET /v2/shipping-groups).
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; the seller supplies carrier and tracking numbers when marking an order unit as sent (PATCH /v2/order-units/{id}/send).
